book.name: Kolosa
book.title: Paulas ke tjietthie Kolosa ke iesaai log khaatien

content: Naawa rakam djiewan

Djab aise hai kie toelog Kriest ke sanghe djaise djie oethaawal gaile hai, tab toelogke tjaahie aapan dhiaan swarag ke tjiedj par lagaawe ke. Hoewa par Kriest Pieta Parmeswar ke dahiena bagal baithal hai.
Oeppar waala tjiedj ke biese me sotj-bietjaar kar, aur na doenia ke tjiedj ke biese me.
Toelog ek maral manai ghat aapan poeraana djiewan tjhor deile hai. Ab toelogke djiewan Kriest ke saath Parmeswar me tjhiepal hai.
Djab Kriest aaike apane ke dekhaaiga, tab tohoelog okar sanghe okar biesaal soekh aur maahaanta me dekhaihe. Oe to hamlogke djiewan hai.

Ohie khaatien roek dja kharaabie kare ke. Toelogke na tjaahie tjhatjhoendaraipan kie to be-saram tjiedj kare ke. Aapan kharaab laalietj poera na kar, aur haahie na rahoe. Dje haahie rahe hai, oe ek naklie bhagwaan ke aadar kare hai, aur na Parmeswar ke.
Dje aise kare hai, okar oeppar Parmeswar ke goessa hai.
Pahiele toelog bhie aisan kharaab rasta par tjalat rahiele.
Bakie ab toelogke tjaahie ie sab baan tjhor dewe ke djaise goessa me rahe, hauwa es baat kare, kharaab sotj-bietjaar kare, koi ke bedjatie kare, aur be-sahoer ghat batiaai ke.
Djhoeth na bol. Toelog to aapan poeraana djiewan tjhor deile hai,

aur djaise koi ek naawa kapra pahien leis hai, oisane toelog ab aapan naawa djiewan bietaawe lagale hai. Aisan manai hardame naawa karwaawal djaaiga. Oe Parmeswar ke auro djaan djaaiga aur ie rakam se oe hardam auro aapan banaawe Waala ghat lagiega.

Aisane sab bieswaasie log okar ghat lagiega. Aur ohie khaatien koetjh baat na hai kie koi Israel ke aadmie hai, okar hakiekat bhail hai, oe pardesie hai, bantjar hai, aur kienal goelaam hai kie na. Ie sab koetjh na hai. Bakie Kriest sab se barka Waala hai, aur oe aapan sab bieswaasie log me rahe hai.
Parmeswar toelogke tjoenke aapan pjaara waalan ghat alag karies hai. Ohie se toelogke tjaahie doesare ke daaja aur bhalaai kare ke, tjhota bane ke, kaida aur dhieradj se rahe ke.
Djab toelog ek doesare me kasoer paawe hai, tab oke sahieke tjhama kariehe. Djaise Prabhoe toelogke paap ke tjhama deis hai, oisane tohoelog ek doesare ke paap ke tjhama deihe.
Aur sab se barka tjiedj hai kie toelog ek doesare ke pjaar kariehe. Pjaar to toelogke poera taur se ekattha kare hai.
Aapan diel me Kriest ke sjaantie ke raadj tjalaawan deihe djeme toelog iesaai ke bhaai-bahien ke sanghe ek man se rahiehe. Aur dhanbaad karte rahiehe.

Kriest ke baat aapan diel me bharmain deihe. Ie baat apane apane me khoeb gjaan se siekhaaw aur samdjhaaw. Parmeswar ke poestak me ke bhadjan aur doesar giet aur gaana diel bhar se gaaw oke dhanbaad dewe khaatien.
Aur tjaahe djaun tjiedj toe bole kie to kare hai, sab koetjh Prabhoe Jiesoe ke naam se kar. Aur Pieta Parmeswar ke okar naam se dhanbaad de.
Ekaat tjietaunie
Biehautie logan, apane ke nietje kar aapan aadmie ke aage. Prabhoe aisane maange hai.
Biehauta logan, aapan aurat ke pjaar kar, aur ose karaai se na rahiehe.
Larkan, hardam aapan maai-baap ke baat soen. Ie Prabhoe ke attjha lage hai.
Baap logan, aapan larkan ke oeppar na hardam katjkatjaaw, nahie to oelog hiemmat haarie.
Bhaai log djaun koi ke kienal goelaam baate, toelog hardam aapan sardaar ke baat soen. Aur na khaalie djab oe taake hai, bakie Prabhoe ke sotjke safa diel se okar baat soen.
Ohie se toe tjaahe djaun kaam kare hai, aapan sab kaam diel bhar se okar khaatien kariehe aur na ek iensaan ke parsand kare khaatien.
Toelog djaane hai kie toelog Prabhoe ke hak paihe. Toelog to Kriest ke aapan Prabhoe ghat maane hai.
Aur jaad kariehe kie dje anniaai kare hai, oe aapan karnie ke phal paaiga. Aur Parmeswar koi ke moeh na taake hai.
